svg.title: Engineering pulse — real project commits
svg.desc: 1072 commits across five public projects, 72 active days, peak 114 commits per day. 2026-08-05 through 2026-10-27 UTC. Each column represents one day; height is proportional to commit count. All authors, default branches, merge commits included. Snapshot 2026-10-27T22:25:25.550Z.
